title: Entertainment webpage
slide_intent: Coordinate image, headline and navigation so the viewer can distinguish the page’s promise from the surrounding controls.
strategic_value: A vivid entertainment hero can give Xfinity’s service offering an emotional entry point while the navigation stays familiar.
demonstration: A webpage pairs black navigation with a magenta hero, white headline at left and two viewers at right, followed by a white content section.
practical_value: Use a change in background to separate a campaign promise from the information that follows it.

content_islands.name: Navigation strip
content_islands.spec: Span the top of the webpage with a dark bar containing the wordmark and service links.

content_islands.name: Magenta hero
content_islands.spec: Place the white headline and small action at left and the people at right on a continuous pink field.

content_islands.name: Next content section
content_islands.spec: Use white below the hero, with a centered headline and a pink phrase linking it back to the campaign color.

reference_purposes.Expression: Magenta joins the outer field, hero background and emphasized words in the next section.
reference_purposes.Application: The composition applies the identity to a service webpage with navigation, campaign and content areas.
